name: ceramics-api

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder sign-in for registered customers; the platform derives end-user-required auth on this service's protected endpoints (cart sync, saved addresses, order history) from this dependency.

dependencies.name: stripe
dependencies.description: Creates and confirms PaymentIntents for checkout; reads the resulting payment status to gate order creation.

config.description: Stripe secret API key used to create/confirm PaymentIntents.
Signing secret to verify Stripe webhook callbacks, if used to confirm async payment status.

dependencies.name: email-provider
dependencies.description: Sends the order-confirmation email (with order reference) after a successful order is created.

description: The single backend for the ceramics storefront: read-only product/variant/category catalog with live stock levels, server-side cart sync for signed-in customers, checkout orchestration (Stripe PaymentIntent creation/confirmation, atomic stock re-validation and decrement, immutable order snapshot creation), order-confirmation email dispatch, and order history/guest lookup. Owns an embedded SQLite database for all of the above. Does NOT provide an admin/back-office UI or API for managing catalog/inventory content — that data is seeded/maintained directly against the database outside this service. Does NOT implement its own login/token endpoints; the platform gateway validates Thunder-issued JWTs and injects X-User-Id / X-User-Groups on protected requests.
